FROM PHUOC TUY SUBSECTOR ABOARD -- LEFT YESTERDAY MORNING (JAN-

THE 64 TROOPS ALREADY ON NAMYIT ISLAND.

exact_quote.text:
3. THE HQ07 (PCE) HAS 17 RF TROOPS ABOARD TO RELIEVE 17 OF

qualification_paragraph.text:
1. UPI REPORTED ON JANUARY 31 THAT A GVN NAVY TASK FORCE
CONSISTING OF THREE SHIPS -- A DESTROYER ESCORT, THE TRAN HUNG
DAO; A CG CUTTER, THE HQ5; AND AN LST WITH ONE COMPANY OF RF
FROM PHUOC TUY SUBSECTOR ABOARD -- LEFT YESTERDAY MORNING (JAN-
UARY 30) FROM VUNG TAU EN ROUTE TO FIVE UNINHABITED ISLANDS OF
THE SPRATLYS. THESE WERE LISTED AS SIN COWE ISLAND, SPRATLY
ISLAND, AMBOYNA CAY, NORTHEAST CAY, AND SAND CAY. THE UPI
STORY POINTS OUT THAT SAND CAY IS NEAR ITU ABA ISLAND, WHERE
THE ROC GARRISON IS STATIONED. (NAMYIT ISLAND WHICH IS ALREADY
OCCUPIED BY ONE RF COMPANY -- MINUS -- IS ALSO IN THE SAME
GROUP AS ITU ABA.)
2. VNN SOURCES HAVE CONFIRMED THAT SUCH AN OPERATION IS IN
PROGRESS. THE TASK FORCE ACTUALLY CONSISTS OF ONE CG CUTTER,
THE HQ5, AND ONE PATROL CRAFT ESCORT, THE HQ07, AND ONE LSM,
THE 405, EN ROUTE TO NAMYIT ISLAND.
3. THE HQ07 (PCE) HAS 17 RF TROOPS ABOARD TO RELIEVE 17 OF
THE 64 TROOPS ALREADY ON NAMYIT ISLAND. LSM 405 HAS 119 TROOPS
ABOARD TO LAND ON THE FIVE ISLANDS LISTED ABOVE (IN GROUPS OF
TWENTY TO THIRTY). THE TASK FORCE IS TO BE ON STATION AT 0400
FEBRUARY 1 AND TO LAND TROOPS NOT LATER THAN 0700 (H).
4. THE OPERATION IS INTENDED ONLY TO CREATE AN RVN PRESENCE
ON THESE ISLANDS IF THEY ARE UNOCCUPIED. THE VNN TASK FORCE
COMMANDER HAS BEEN ORDERED NOT REPEAT NOT TO ENGAGE IN ANY
HOSTILE ACTION TOWARD ANY FORCES WHICH MIGHT BE IN THE AREA
AND NOT TO ATTEMPT TO LAND TROOPS ON ANY OCCUPIED ISLANDS.
MARTIN
